Type: small square shag rug
Use: soft spot beside a bed or in front of a chair; bedroom, living room, kids room
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: long thick synthetic shag pile
Colors: medium grey, cool tone
Shape: small square with dense fluffy shag, soft uneven edges, solid color, plush
Feel: cozy, soft, relaxed
Goes with: white or grey furniture, light wood, black accents; modern, Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms and reading corners

product.name: HAMPEN
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
